meta.product: 2-m Class Coastal AUV — 100 m rated, 24-hour endurance, modular sonar payload
meta.bom_source: Engineering knowledge construction from brief baseline-10/08-auv-coastal.md. Representative 25-line BoM: titanium pressure hull (main cylinder + nose + tail), syntactic foam buoyancy trim, 12 kWh oil-compensated Li-ion battery pack + BMS, 2 × brushless thrusters + propellers, 4 × rudder/elevator servos, inertial navigation + Doppler velocity log, acoustic modem transducer, GPS + Iridium masthead, pressure-depth sensor, wet-mate payload connector, obstacle-avoidance sonar, leak detector, emergency drop weight, Wi-Fi antenna, recovery beacon + strobe.

library_state_at_entry.note: Post-Week-4 library, same as CGM entry state (CGM added 0 radicals).

meta.council_prediction: 1 possible new radical — hydrodynamic_propulsion_function for thrusters. Test: does fluid_flow_state + electromechanical_switching_function + composite_fibre_material suffice for a brushless propeller drive? Also test: does pressure_vessel_function cover depth-rated hull (process-pressure vs hydrostatic)?
meta.decomposition_methodology: Manual. Post-Week-4 library applies. Library grows incrementally within this product.

new_radicals_added_this_product.rationale: Acoustic modem transducer and Doppler velocity log operate by generating and receiving mechanical pressure waves through water. This function class is irreducible to existing radicals: it is distinct from chemical_sensing_function (no chemical analyte), optical_sensing_function (acoustic, not photon), electrical_conducting_function (mechanical wave, not charge), fluid_flow_state (wave propagation through a medium, not bulk fluid motion), and pressure_vessel_function (pressure containment, not wave transduction). Underwater acoustic communication and USBL/DVL navigation are defining enabling technologies for the AUV domain. The radical covers both active sonar (transmit + receive) and passive acoustic sensing.

new_radicals_rationale: 1 new radical added: acoustic_wave_function. All other 24 lines decompose from existing radicals. Key test cases: (1) titanium pressure hull — pressure_vessel_function covers depth-rated hydrostatic loading (same radical as process-pressure vessels; the physics is hydrostatic pressure containment regardless of source); 316L_grade modifier overrides corrosion to marine-resistant, titanium_grade modifier captures alloy properties. (2) Brushless thruster — electromechanical_switching_function (motor) + fluid_flow_state (propeller-fluid coupling) + composite_fibre_material (propeller blade) adequately covers the thruster without a new radical. (3) Syntactic foam — mineral_fibre_material covers glass-microballoon-filled epoxy syntactic foam (same mineral/glass-based composition class). (4) Oil-compensated battery — existing electrochemical_energy_function + fluid_flow_state (oil compensation) + pressure_vessel_function (housing) suffice. Acoustic modem and DVL require acoustic_wave_function.

bom_lines.name: Titanium Pressure Hull — Main Cylinder (Ti-6Al-4V, 100 m rated)

decomposition.rationale: pressure_vessel covers hydrostatic pressure containment at 100 m (10 bar). titanium_6al4v_grade encodes marine corrosion immunity and high strength-to-weight. Same character as BESS/HP process vessels — different pressure source (hydrostatic vs. process), same function.

bom_lines.name: Titanium Pressure Hull — Nose Cone (Ti-6Al-4V, hydrodynamic fairing)
Titanium Pressure Hull — Tail Section (Ti-6Al-4V, thruster interface)
Syntactic Foam Buoyancy Module (glass microballoon-epoxy, 100 m rated)

decomposition.rationale: Syntactic foam is a new character — a depth-rated buoyancy material (glass microspheres in epoxy matrix). mineral_fibre_material covers the glass-phase (same material class as glass wool, mineral fibre); polymer_thermoplastic covers the epoxy matrix. No new radical. The thermal_insulation_panel character is matched by structural analogy (panel of mineral/polymer composite) but a distinct character is needed for the AUV buoyancy function.

bom_lines.name: 12 kWh Li-Ion Battery Pack — oil-compensated pressure-balanced housing

decomposition.rationale: Oil compensation (pressure equalisation via mineral oil bladder) means fluid_flow_state correctly applies. pressure_vessel_function covers the housing. electrochemical_energy_function covers the cells. No new radical.

bom_lines.name: Battery Management System (BMS) — marine-rated, over-temperature + depth protection
Brushless Thruster Motor (2 × main drive, 300W continuous, 24V DC)

decomposition.rationale: A brushless thruster motor is distinct from ec_fan_motor — it drives a propeller in seawater requiring magnetically sealed wet windings. electromechanical_switching_function (BLDC commutation) + magnetic_coupling_function (magnetic sealing) cover the function. No new radical needed.

bom_lines.name: Propeller — carbon-fibre, 3-blade, 150mm dia, marine-antifouled

decomposition.rationale: axial_fan_blade covers the fluid-coupled rotating airfoil function. Marine propeller differs only by medium (water vs air) and antifouling treatment — both captured by modifiers. composite_fibre_material covers CFRP blade. fluid_flow_state covers hydrodynamic thrust generation. No new radical.

bom_lines.name: Electronic Speed Controller (ESC) — 2 × 300W brushless, 24V
Control Surface Servos — 4 × (rudder + elevator + aileron + spoiler)

decomposition.rationale: A depth-rated control surface servo is distinct from ec_fan_motor — it has a gearbox, position feedback, and must operate at depth. electromechanical_switching_function covers actuation. No new radical.

bom_lines.name: Inertial Navigation System (INS) + IMU (MEMS, tactical grade)

decomposition.rationale: INS/IMU uses MEMS accelerometers and gyroscopes — chemical_sensing_function covers inertial sensing (same physical principle: displacement → electrical signal). The character adds INS-specific fusion and navigation output. No new radical.

bom_lines.name: Doppler Velocity Log (DVL) — 4-beam ADCP, 600 kHz, bottom-lock

decomposition.rationale: DVL measures velocity by Doppler shift of acoustic pulses reflected from the seabed. Requires acoustic_wave_function — cannot be reduced to optical, chemical, or electromagnetic sensing. This is the radical that AUV genuinely requires.

bom_lines.name: Acoustic Modem Transducer (USBL, 2-way, 9.6 kbps, 2000 m range)
Pressure / Depth Sensor (Keller PAA-35X or equivalent, 0–150 m, 0.1% FS)

decomposition.rationale: A depth pressure sensor is distinct from pressure_switch (binary on/off). It provides continuous analog depth measurement. chemical_sensing_function (piezoresistive sensing) + pressure_vessel_function (media isolation). No new radical.

bom_lines.name: GPS + Iridium Masthead Assembly (pop-up mast, surface only)

decomposition.rationale: A satellite comms antenna is distinct from pcb_controller — it is an RF radiating element with feed network, not a compute platform. silicon_semiconductor_function covers the GNSS/Iridium chipset. No new radical.

bom_lines.name: 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi Pop-Up Antenna Module (surface comms, IEEE 802.11n)
Forward-Looking Obstacle-Avoidance Sonar (mechanically scanned, 900 kHz)

decomposition.rationale: Imaging sonar is distinct from DVL (velocity measurement). It forms acoustic images for obstacle detection. acoustic_wave_function + electromechanical_switching_function (mechanical scan). No new radical.

bom_lines.name: Main Mission Computer / Autopilot PCB (ARM SoC, 100BASE-T Ethernet backbone)
Wet-Mate Payload Connector (SubConn or Cobalt, 12-pin, 150 m rated)

decomposition.rationale: Wet-mate connector (matable underwater at depth) is distinct from copper_terminal (dry crimp). electrical_conducting_function covers contacts; polymer_thermoplastic covers keyed body. No new radical.

bom_lines.name: Leak Detector — resistive water ingress sensor (hull breach alert)
Emergency Drop Weight (electro-corrosive release, 2 kg lead ballast)

decomposition.rationale: Drop weight uses sacrificial galvanic corrosion triggered electrically — steel + electrical_conducting_function. Character needed for the safety-release mechanism. No new radical.

bom_lines.name: Recovery Beacon + Strobe (RF 121.5 MHz + xenon flash, IP68)

decomposition.rationale: photon_emission_function covers xenon strobe; silicon_semiconductor_function covers RF beacon IC; electrical_conducting_function covers antenna. New character for combined emergency recovery function. No new radical.

bom_lines.name: Power Distribution PCB + Fusing (24V bus, IP68 sealed)
Internal Wiring Harness — Ethernet + power + signal (Seacon connectors)
Modular Payload Bay Shell (CFRP tube, wet-mate interface, 30 cm section)

decomposition.rationale: composite_fibre_material (CFRP tube) + pressure_vessel_function (depth-rated shell). New character for payload-bay-specific function. No new radical.

radical_reuse.definition: Lines where all radicals were already in library at time of decomposition
radical_reuse.note: Line 12 (DVL) triggers acoustic_wave_function. Lines 13 and 17 (acoustic modem, imaging sonar) then reuse it.

character_reuse.definition: Lines where an existing character was directly matched
